# Teddy Warner

> Teddy Warner is an inventor and Thiel Fellow based in San Francisco. He created Avian Visitors, an e-paper frame that collages nearby birds, and is building Stratolink, an open-source network of stratospheric balloons.

Teddy specializes in rapid prototyping and enjoys thinking about design. His work ranges from consumer electronics to balloon networks and art machines: things made to bring the world a little closer, or just make it more interesting.

He is a 2025 Thiel Fellow and a graduate of the Fab Academy. He previously did hardware research at Midjourney and founded Intempus.

## Projects

- [Avian Visitors](https://theodore.net/projects/AvianVisitors/): A battery-powered e-paper frame that collages birds heard near your ZIP code.
- [Stratolink](https://stratolink.org/): An open-source network of small, solar-powered balloons built to collect and share data from the stratosphere. Anyone can build and launch a payload.
- [Generative Pen-trained Transformer](https://theodore.net/projects/Polargraph/): A wall-mounted drawing machine that makes generative art with a pen.
- [Von Niemann Probe](https://theodore.net/projects/VonNiemannProbe/): A chess cheating investigation device.
- [Assistive Aquaponics](https://theodore.net/projects/AssistiveAquaponics/): An automated ecosystem monitoring system.
- [UPDI Serial Programming](https://theodore.net/projects/SerialUPDI/): Low-cost, high-speed AVR programming.

## Key Facts

- Role: Inventor
- Recognition: 2025 Thiel Fellow
- Education: Fab Academy graduate
- Previous work: Hardware research at Midjourney; founder of Intempus
- Location: San Francisco, California
- Interests: Rapid prototyping, design, electronics, digital fabrication, and machines
